title: Membership-query bound for the learner
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, and let $M$ be a positive integer. For every output and cost pair in the support of the Kushilevitz–Mansour program run with target $f$, accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$, and parameter $M$, the number $q$ of membership queries satisfies $q\le Q+640A^4/\varepsilon^2$, where $A=\left\lceil 4/\tau^2\right\rceil$, $\tau=\varepsilon/(4M)$, and $Q=n\cdot 2A\cdot 2\left\lceil 2L/\eta^2\right\rceil$, with $L=\left\lceil\log_2\left\lceil 2/\delta\right\rceil\right\rceil$, $\eta=\tau^2/4$, and $\delta=1/[40(n+1)(A+1)]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from the $n$-cube to signs
